50/S0.subgoal: State the objective of the lecture and outline the four stages of model development.

50/S1.subgoal: Describe the empirical research methodology used to gather walking data from participants.

50/S2.subgoal: Analyze the collected walking data to identify the natural velocity pattern followed by participants.

50/S3.subgoal: Propose and derive a mathematical model for virtual scene speed using visual gain and Fourier series approximation.

50/S4.subgoal: Evaluate the proposed walking speed model by comparing its realism against constant speed in an empirical study.

50/S5.subgoal: Summarize the findings of the study and identify remaining concerns regarding cyber sickness in VR systems.
